λαθικηδέα: λαθικηδής — soothing sorrow, banishing care, making one forget cares; adj. (2 endings), masc. acc. sg., agreeing with μαζόν
λαμπρότατος: λαμπρός — bright, brilliant; superl. λαμπρότατος, masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’brightest’
λιάσθης: λιάζομαι — turn aside, swerve; aor. 2 sg. pass. dep., epic unaugmented (= ἐλιάσθης): ’you turned aside’
λυκάονα: Λυκάων — Lycaon, a son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.

μόρσιμός: μόρσιμος — fated, destined; adj. (2 endings), masc. nom. sg., predicate, accented before the enclitic εἰμι: ’one fated (to be killed by you)’
νεβροὶ: νεβρός — fawn; masc. nom. pl., grave accent mid-clause: ’fawns’
οἴκτιστον: οἰκτρός — pitiable, piteous; superl. οἴκτιστος, neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’most pitiable’

πέδησεν: πεδάω — bind, fetter, hold fast; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐπέδησεν): ’held fast’
πίον: πίνω — drink; aor. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= ἔπιον): ’they drank’
παμφαίνονθ: παμφαίνω — shine brightly, gleam; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (παμφαίνονθ’ = παμφαίνοντα): ’gleaming’
παρείη: πάρειμι — be at hand, be present (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were at hand’
περνὰς: πέρνημι — sell (abroad); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic πιπράσκων): ’selling’
πηλείωνα: Πηλείων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. acc. sg.
πιόντες: πίνω — drink; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having drunk’
πολιὰς: πολιός — grey, hoary; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with τρίχας
πυρετὸν: πυρετός — fever, burning heat; masc. acc. sg.
πύματόν: πύματος — last, final; masc. acc. sg., predicative with με: ’last of all’ (acute added by the enclitic με)
σάωσας: σαόω (Attic σῴζω) — save, rescue; aor. 2 sg. act., epic unaugmented (= ἐσάωσας): ’you saved’
σευάμενος: σεύω — drive, hurry; mid. rush, dart; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., from the epic aor. (ἐσσευάμην, σεύατο): ’darting’
σκαιάων: σκαιός — left, western; πύλαι Σκαιαί the Scaean Gates of Troy; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), agreeing with πυλάων
τίλλων: τίλλω — pluck, tear out; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’tearing out’
τίσιν: τίσις — retribution, requital, vengeance; fem. acc. sg., object of ἔδεισας: ’(fear) retribution’
τεκόμεσθα: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic ending -μεσθα, unaugmented (= Attic ἐτεκόμεθα)
τισαίμην: τίνω — pay; mid. τίνυμαι, exact vengeance on, punish; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg., with ἄν: ’I would take vengeance on’
τιταινόμενος: τιταίνω — stretch, strain; mid. strain oneself; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
τοσσόνδε: τοσόσδε (epic τοσσόσδε, with -δε and double σ) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, correlative with ὅσσον: ’so much’
τραπεζῆας: τραπεζεύς — (dog) fed at the table; masc. acc. pl., Ionic -ῆας (= Attic -έας): ’table-dogs’
τρῳάς: Τρῳάς — Trojan woman; fem. acc. pl.: ’Trojan women’
υἷάς: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
φαίνονται: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, show oneself; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’appear’
χέουσ: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (χέουσ’ = χέουσα): ’shedding’
ἀεθλοφόρος: ἀεθλοφόρος — prize-winning, victorious in the contest; adj. (2 endings), masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἀθλοφόρος)
ἀλύσσοντες: ἀλύσσω — be beside oneself, be frantic; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’maddened’
ἀμερθῇς: ἀμέρδω — deprive, rob (of + gen.); aor. subj. pass. 2 sg.: ’you be robbed of’
ἀνιεμένη: ἀνίημι — let loose, loosen; mid. loosen (one’s own garment); pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’loosening’

ἀστράσι: ἀστήρ — star; masc. dat. pl., after μετά: ’among the stars’

ἄλτης: Ἄλτης — Altes, king of the Leleges, father of Laothoe; masc. nom. sg.
ἄνευθ: ἄνευθε(ν) (elided ἄνευθ’) — far off, apart from; adv., or prep. + gen. (ἄνευθ’ ἄλλων ’apart from others’)
ἐγεγώνει: γεγωνέω — call aloud, shout; impf. 3 sg.: ’called aloud’
ἐπάλξεσιν: ἔπαλξις — battlement, parapet; fem. dat. pl., after κεκλιμένοι

ἐπέσχον: ἐπέχω — hold out, offer; aor. 1 sg. act. (stem σχ-, ἔσχον): ’I held out’
ἐπιδόντα: ἐφοράω — look upon, witness; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg. (aor. ἐπεῖδον), agreeing with ὅν: ’having seen’
ἐρύουσιν: ἐρύω (εἰρύω) — drag, draw; pres. 3 pl. act. with ἄν, of what is to come: ’they will drag’
ἐφόβησας: φοβέω — frighten, put to flight; aor. 2 sg. act., augmented: ’you put to flight’
ἑλκηθείσας: ἑλκέω (ἕλκω) — drag; aor. part. pass. fem. acc. pl.: ’dragged off’
ἑλκομένας: ἕλκω — drag, draw; pres. part. pass. fem. acc. pl.: ’being dragged’
ἔβλαψάς: βλάπτω — hinder, thwart, harm; aor. 2 sg. act., accent shifted by the enclitic μ’: ’you have harmed’
ἔδεισας: δείδω — fear; aor. 2 sg. act. (ἔδεισα), + acc.: ’you feared’
ἔδοιεν: ἔδω (= ἐσθίω) — eat, devour; pres. opt. 3 pl., potential with κέν: ’would eat’
ὀλοιὴ: ὀλοιός (ὀλοός) — destructive, baneful; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with μοῖρα
ὀλοώτατε: ὀλοός — destructive, baneful; superl. ὀλοώτατος, masc. voc. sg.: ’most baneful’
ὀλοῇς: ὀλοός — destructive, baneful; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with χερσίν
ὀνομάκλυτος: ὀνομάκλυτος — of famous name, renowned; adj. (2 endings), masc. nom. sg.
ὀπώρης: ὀπώρη — late summer, autumn; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic ὀπώρας), gen. of time: ’in late summer’
ὀρέξῃς: ὀρέγω — stretch out, offer, grant; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., in a negative purpose clause continuing ὄφρα, after μή: ’(that you) not offer’

__broaden__.αἴσῃ: αἶσα — portion, lot, fate; fem. dat. sg.: ’by an evil lot’ (κακῇ αἴσῃ) · also fem. dat. sg., of cause with πεπρωμένον: ’by lot’ (πεπρωμένον αἴσῃ ’fated by lot’) · also fem. dat. sg., of means with ἐν: ’by a grievous lot’ (ἐν ἀργαλέῃ αἴσῃ)
__broaden__.αὐτήν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg., as a plain pronoun: ’her’ (καὶ αὐτήν ’and her too’) · also intensive, fem. acc. sg.: ’itself’ (κανόνας τε καὶ αὐτήν ’the rods and the shield itself’) · also fem. acc. sg. as a plain pronoun after ἐπί, of a thing: ’to it’ (ἐπ’ αὐτήν ’to it’) · also intensive, 1st person, fem. acc. sg., with the speaker as object: ’me myself’ (μ’ ἐλέησον αὐτήν ’pity me myself’)
__broaden__.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’ · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ · also κ’ + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κ’ … ὀνόσαιτ’ ’nor would … make light of’) · also εἴ … κ’ + fut. indic. in a condition: ’if … shall’ (εἴ κ’ … ἑλκήσουσιν ’if … drag’) · also κ’ + aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (ἦ κ’ ἐδάμην ’I would have been subdued’) · also κ’ + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὁπποῖόν κ’ εἴπῃσθα ’whatever sort you say’) · also κ’ + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will, in that case’ (οἵ κ’ … κείσοντ’ ’who will lie’)
__broaden__.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’ · also εἰς ὅ κέ + fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ σ’ … ποιήσεται ’until he makes you’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (καί κέ τις … ἐρέει ’someone will say’) · also ὄφρά κέ + subj.: ’until’ (… κέ … ἐνείκω ’until I bring’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so … might’ · also with an aor. indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κέ τοι … φάνη ’there would have appeared to you’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κέ τίς … ἀτιμήσειε ’no one would dishonour’) · also εἴ κέ in an indirect question, + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj.: ’whether’ (εἴ κέ … ἀπώσεται ’whether he will thrust back’) · also εἰ … κέ + short-vowel subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ (εἰ … κέ σε … ἀπολύσομεν ’if we should release you’) · also εἰς ὅ κέ + long-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ … ἕληται ’until he takes’) · also + short-vowel subj. in a main clause: ’shall’ (ἐγὼ δέ κέ τοι ἰδέω χάριν ’I shall acknowledge the favour’) · also + pres. indic. in a main clause, generic: ’would’ (καί κέ τις εὔχεται ’any man would pray’) · also εἴ κέ + long-vowel subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ (εἴ κέ μ’ … συλήσωσι ’if … should strip me’) · also with a relative + subj. in a general clause: ’whoever’ (ὅς κέ … ἔλθῃ ’whoever comes’) · also ἐπεί κέ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’once, when’ (ἐπεί κέ τις … ἕληται ’once someone takes’)
__broaden__.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸν οἶτον ’an evil doom’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate noun: ’an evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., adj. with ὄναρ: ’evil (dream)’ · also neut. nom. sg. as a noun, subject: ’evil’ (κακὸν κακῷ ’evil upon evil’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate adj. with σῆμα: ’an evil (sign)’
__broaden__.μίμνε: μίμνω — stay, remain, hold firm; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμιμνε), epic reduplicated by-form of μένω: ’stayed’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg. (μίμνε = μένε), + acc.: ’wait for, stand against’ (μίμνε ἀνέρα ’await the man’)
__broaden__.μενεαίνεις: μενεαίνω — be eager, be set on (doing); pres. 2 sg., epic, + inf.: ’you are eager’ · also pres. 2 sg., absolute, no infinitive: ’you are eager’ (ἀσπερχὲς μενεαίνεις ’you are eager without pause’)
__broaden__.νέῳ: νέος — young; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’(to me,) young’ · also masc. dat. sg. as a noun: ’for a young man’
__broaden__.πολλὸν: πολύς — much; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’by far’ · also neut. acc. sg. adjective, agreeing with φῦκος: ’much (seaweed)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱδρῶ: ’much (sweat)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, with τρόφι: ’greatly’ (πολλὸν … τρόφι ’greatly swollen’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πυρετόν: ’much (fever)’
__broaden__.πραπίδων: πραπίδες — midriff, the parts about the liver; fem. gen. pl. (plural only), after ὑπό: ’beneath the midriff’ · also fem. gen. pl. after ἀπό: ’from the midriff’, i.e. from the heart
__broaden__.προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also adv. in tmesis with a verb of following: ’along with it’ (προτὶ … ἕποντο ’followed along with it’) · also + dat.: ’to, against’ (προτὶ γαίῃ ’against the ground’)
__broaden__.πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form) · also conj. + opt., after a negative in past time: ’before, until’ (πρὶν πειρήσαιτ’ ’until he made trial’) · also conj. + inf.: ’before’ (πρὶν … εἰσαφικέσθαι ’before reaching’)
__broaden__.σαώσῃς: σαόω (Attic σῴζω) — save, rescue; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., in an indirect question with κε: ’you may save’ · also aor. subj. 2 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that you may save’
__broaden__.τούς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’, accented before the enclitic γε · also relative, masc. acc. pl., accented before the enclitic μοι: ’whom’
__broaden__.ἀστέρ: ἀστήρ — star; masc. dat. sg., elided (ἀστέρ’ = ἀστέρι), after ἐναλίγκιον · also masc. acc. sg., elided (ἀστέρ’ = ἀστέρα), in a comparison after ὥς τε: ’like a star’
__broaden__.ἄμυνε: ἀμύνω — ward off, keep off; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἤμυνε): ’warded off’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’ward off!’ (+ acc. of the foe)
__broaden__.ἄρηϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει) · also Ἄρης personified as war: ’in war’, dat. of means
__broaden__.ἐπίσπῃς: ἐφέπω (aor. ἐπέσπον) — follow up; meet, undergo (a fate); aor. subj. 2 sg. act., after ἐπεὶ ἂν: ’you have met’ · also aor. subj. 2 sg. act., in a negative purpose clause after ἵνα μή: ’lest you meet’
__broaden__.ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg., in an indefinite relative clause: ’(whoever) might come’ · also after ὁππότε in past sequence, of an awaited event: ’should come’ (ποτιδέγμενοι ὁππότ’ ἄρ’ ἔλθοι ’waiting for when he should come’) · also after ἐπεὶ ἂν, potential: ’he would come’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause of hoped-for outcome: ’might come’ (καὶ ἂψ … ἔλθοι ’and might come back’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα μή: ’and he come’ (ὃ δὲ δεύτερος ἔλθοι ’and he come second’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a condition after εἰ: ’(if) he were to come’ (εἰ δ’ … ἔλθοι) · also aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would come, would go’ (ἀπὸ πραπίδων ἄχος ἔλθοι ’grief would go from the heart’)
__broaden__.ἕληται: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., after εἰς ὅ κε ’until’ (= Attic ἕως ἂν …); with ἐκ in tmesis, ’take out’ · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., with ἀπό in tmesis, in an indirect deliberation: ’should strip off’ (ἀπὸ … ἕληται) · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ὁππότε: ’takes’ (θυμὸν … ἕληται ’take his life’) · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a temporal clause after ἐπεί κε: ’once he takes’ (θυμὸν ἐκ … ἕληται)
